messages.subject: more updates
parts:
Hi!

We've finished our fourth sprint of work on GBM.  We have finished simplifying the decision tree growing code and finished off applying appropriate design patterns.  We also did a bit of work running GBM with UBSAN compiler flags enabled and finding and fixing the errors that produced.

The tree growing algorithm is now more readily parallelisable via OpenMP and has modified the searching so that better splits are identified when growing a tree.  These changes mean that results may change slightly from before and the algorithm is more computationally intensive, and hence slower.  A future sprint will be aimed at optimization.

We are now - in sprint 5 - updating the Cox proportional hazards distribution with code provided by Terry Therneau, which should fix our Cox bugs and also add in quite a bit of additional functionality.

After this we're planning on updating the R front-end in sprint 6, in preparation for documentation, testing and optimization to follow.

Again, complaints, comments, and suggestions are very welcome!

--
pdm
